items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Dick Sherman has got me listening to George Brunies and as I listen to him I think wow.

ctx.x: Right. I think it’s how musicians usually learn music is they grab what’s happening at the time and then if they get interested to go backwards they will. Like gee where did this come from, who do you suppose these people listened to.
That’s exactly what’s happened to me. I mean now at the age of 69 I’m actually going back and listening to Kid Ory and George Brunies and some of these people and it’s remarkable stuff.
And the people you played for, did you ever have some of the frat fellas like, “Play some rock & roll?”
